leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the vein was the least engaging part: the named slot and only offered combination made it straightforward, and the picture added little to the explanation.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how the unfinished colon wall is assembled, though I'd hope for more meaningful choices than the last two combinations.
